properties.natural_language: All data received via Full node sends light client update from EXT-FULL-NODE-P2P must be validated before processing. All light client updates must be cryptographically verified: BLS aggregate signature verification over sync committee, Merkle branch verification for finality and execution payload proofs, slot ordering validation, and minimum participation threshold checks.
If input from EXT-FULL-NODE-P2P via Full node sends light client update fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
Before Validate Light Client Update can execute, the system must be in Light Client Update Received.
After Validate Light Client Update completes, the system must transition to Update Passes Validation with all state invariants preserved.
Before Compare Against Best Update can execute, the system must be in Update Passes Validation.
After Compare Against Best Update completes, Apply Update to Store must proceed as specified by: Update meets application criteria (supermajority or force update).
After Apply Update to Store completes, the system must transition to Light Client Store Updated with all state invariants preserved.
While in Light Client Store Initialized: LightClientStore has been bootstrapped with a trusted block root, current sync committee, and Merkle proof.
Before Verify Slot Ordering can execute, the system must be in Incoming Update Pending Validation.
After Verify Slot Ordering completes, Check Minimum Participation must proceed as specified by: Slot ordering valid.
After Check Minimum Participation completes, Verify Period Constraint must proceed as specified by: Sufficient participants.
After Verify Period Constraint completes, Verify Merkle Branches must proceed as specified by: Period constraint satisfied.
After Verify Merkle Branches completes, Verify BLS Aggregate Signature must proceed as specified by: Merkle proofs valid.
After Verify BLS Aggregate Signature completes, the system must transition to All Validation Checks Passed with all state invariants preserved.
After Verify Slot Ordering completes, the system must transition to Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.
After Check Minimum Participation completes, the system must transition to Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.
After Verify Period Constraint completes, the system must transition to Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.
After Verify Merkle Branches completes, the system must transition to Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.
After Verify BLS Aggregate Signature completes, the system must transition to Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.

All data received via User provides trusted root from EXT-USER-TRUST-SOURCE must be validated before processing. The trusted block root MUST correspond to a canonical chain block. If this root is compromised, all subsequent light client validation is compromised. This is the root of trust for the entire light client protocol. Users must obtain this via reliable out-of-band channels.
If input from EXT-USER-TRUST-SOURCE via User provides trusted root fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
After Initialize Store from Bootstrap completes, the system must transition to Safety Threshold Active with all state invariants preserved.
Before Evaluate Optimistic Header Safety can execute, the system must be in Safety Threshold Active.
Before Evaluate Finality Safety can execute, the system must be in Safety Threshold Active.
Before Force Update on Timeout can execute, the system must be in Safety Threshold Active.
After Evaluate Finality Safety completes, the system must transition to Finalized Header Advanced with all state invariants preserved.
After Force Update on Timeout completes, the system must transition to Finalized Header Advanced with all state invariants preserved.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-ALTAIR-LC-01): MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS is set to 1, meaning a single validator signature is sufficient for a valid update. The security implications of this low threshold are not discussed. — the system must enforce: Assume the minimum of 1 is for liveness guarantees only. Actual security relies on the is_better_update ranking and the safety_threshold mechanism which requires higher participation for header advancement.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-ALTAIR-LC-02): The force update mechanism 'promotes' the attested header to finalized when UPDATE_TIMEOUT elapses. The exact conditions under which this could lead to accepting a non-finalized header are not fully specified. — the system must enforce: Assume force updates are a liveness trade-off that sacrifices strict finality guarantees. The best_valid_update still required cryptographic validity, so force updates can only promote headers that had valid sync committee signatures.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-ALTAIR-LC-03): The is_valid_normalized_merkle_branch function 'allows leading zero hashes' but does not define what constitutes a valid sparse proof versus an invalid truncated proof. — the system must enforce: Assume any Merkle branch where leading zeros correspond to empty subtrees in the beacon state is valid. The branch must still produce the correct root when computed.

The system assumes: The initial trusted block root obtained by the user is correct and corresponds to a canonical chain block.. If violated: An attacker providing a malicious trusted root could bootstrap the light client onto a forged chain, completely compromising all subsequent header validation.

The system assumes: An attacker cannot control 2/3 or more of the sync committee validators to forge finality updates.. If violated: With 2/3 sync committee control, an attacker could forge finality proofs pointing to an invalid chain, causing the light client to accept fraudulent state.

The system assumes: The light client will receive at least one valid update within the UPDATE_TIMEOUT period under normal network conditions.. If violated: Persistent network partitioning could cause repeated force updates, potentially degrading the quality of the light client's finalized view.
Before Iterate Through Receipts can execute, the system must be in Block Execution Complete.
After Iterate Through Receipts completes, Filter Deposit Contract Logs must proceed as specified by: Apply deposit contract filter.
After Filter Deposit Contract Logs completes, the system must transition to Deposit Logs Identified with all state invariants preserved.
Before Extract Deposit Data can execute, the system must be in Deposit Logs Identified.
After Extract Deposit Data completes, the system must transition to Deposit Requests Ready with all state invariants preserved.

All data received via Begin deposit data validation from EXT-PEER-VIA-P2P must be validated before processing. Full block validation required: header fields, gas limit bounds, PoW/PoS validity, transaction execution correctness, state root verification. All data from peers is potentially malicious.
If input from EXT-PEER-VIA-P2P via Begin deposit data validation fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
After Validate Data Length completes, Validate Pubkey Offset must proceed as specified by: Length valid, check pubkey offset.
After Validate Pubkey Offset completes, Validate Pubkey Size must proceed as specified by: Check pubkey size.
After Validate Pubkey Size completes, Validate Withdrawal Credentials Offset must proceed as specified by: Check withdrawal credentials.
After Validate Withdrawal Credentials Offset completes, Validate Withdrawal Credentials Size must proceed as specified by: Check size.
After Validate Withdrawal Credentials Size completes, Validate Amount Offset must proceed as specified by: Check amount.
After Validate Amount Offset completes, Validate Amount Size must proceed as specified by: Check size.
After Validate Amount Size completes, Validate Signature Offset must proceed as specified by: Check signature.
After Validate Signature Offset completes, Validate Signature Size must proceed as specified by: Check size.
After Validate Signature Size completes, Validate Index Offset must proceed as specified by: Check index.
After Validate Index Offset completes, Validate Index Size must proceed as specified by: Check size.
After Validate Index Size completes, the system must transition to Deposit Data Valid with all state invariants preserved.
Before Extract Deposit Fields can execute, the system must be in Deposit Data Valid.
After Validate Data Length completes, the system must transition to Invalid Block Exception with all state invariants preserved.
After Validate Pubkey Offset completes, the system must transition to Invalid Block Exception with all state invariants preserved.
Before Hash Each Request can execute, the system must be in All Requests Collected.
After Hash Each Request completes, the system must transition to Individual Hashes Computed with all state invariants preserved.
Before Chain Hashes Together can execute, the system must be in Individual Hashes Computed.
After Chain Hashes Together completes, the system must transition to Final Requests Hash with all state invariants preserved.
Before Check Request Type Prefix can execute, the system must be in Request Pending Classification.
After Check Request Type Prefix completes, the system must transition to Deposit Request (0x00) with all state invariants preserved.
After Check Request Type Prefix completes, the system must transition to Withdrawal Request (0x01) with all state invariants preserved.
After Check Request Type Prefix completes, the system must transition to Consolidation Request (0x02) with all state invariants preserved.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-REQUESTS-01): The specification does not explicitly define behavior when the deposit contract emits malformed log data that passes length check but has incorrect internal structure — the system must enforce: Assume the fixed offset/size validation catches all malformed data. If a log passes validation but contains semantically invalid data (e.g., invalid pubkey), it's the consensus layer's responsibility to reject it.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-REQUESTS-02): The phrase 'chain hashes together' is vague about the exact concatenation and hashing order for compute_requests_hash — the system must enforce: Assume hashes are concatenated in request type order (deposits, then withdrawals, then consolidations) and a final SHA256 is computed over the concatenation.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-REQUESTS-03): It's unclear whether an empty list of requests produces a zero hash, empty hash, or some other sentinel value — the system must enforce: Assume SHA256 of empty input returns the standard SHA256 hash of empty string.

The system assumes: The deposit contract at 0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa is trusted and cannot emit fraudulent deposit events. If violated: A compromised or malicious deposit contract could inject fake deposits, allowing unauthorized validators to join the network

The system assumes: The deposit contract event signature hash (0x649bbc62...) is unique and cannot be emitted by other contracts. If violated: Topic collision could allow malicious contracts to spoof deposit events if they somehow match the signature

The system assumes: An attacker cannot modify transaction receipts after block execution. If violated: Receipt tampering could allow injection or removal of deposit requests, corrupting the validator set

The system assumes: Deposit requests are processed in order and the index field is monotonically increasing. If violated: Out-of-order or duplicate index values could cause deposit processing failures or duplicates
Before Read MCOPY Opcode (0x5E) can execute, the system must be in EVM Executing Bytecode.
After Read MCOPY Opcode (0x5E) completes, Pop Stack Arguments must proceed as specified by: Get stack arguments.
After Pop Stack Arguments completes, the system must transition to Arguments Retrieved with all state invariants preserved.
Before Calculate Words Copied can execute, the system must be in Arguments Retrieved.
After Calculate Words Copied completes, Calculate Memory Expansion must proceed as specified by: Check memory bounds.
After Calculate Memory Expansion completes, Calculate Total Gas Cost must proceed as specified by: Include expansion cost.
After Calculate Total Gas Cost completes, the system must transition to Gas Cost Determined with all state invariants preserved.
Before Check Sufficient Gas can execute, the system must be in Gas Cost Determined.
After Check Sufficient Gas completes, the system must transition to Out of Gas with all state invariants preserved.
After Check Sufficient Gas completes, Deduct Gas must proceed as specified by: Sufficient gas.
After Deduct Gas completes, Expand Memory If Needed must proceed as specified by: Prepare memory.
After Expand Memory If Needed completes, Copy Memory Bytes must proceed as specified by: Execute copy.
After Copy Memory Bytes completes, the system must transition to Memory Copy Complete with all state invariants preserved.
Before Calculate Base Cost can execute, the system must be in MCOPY Gas Calculation Started.
After Calculate Base Cost completes, Calculate Per-Word Copy Cost must proceed as specified by: Add copy cost.
After Calculate Per-Word Copy Cost completes, Calculate Current Memory Cost must proceed as specified by: Check memory.
After Calculate Current Memory Cost completes, Calculate New Memory Size must proceed as specified by: Determine new bounds.
After Calculate New Memory Size completes, Calculate New Memory Cost must proceed as specified by: Cost new size.
After Calculate New Memory Cost completes, Calculate Expansion Cost Delta must proceed as specified by: Compute delta.
After Calculate Expansion Cost Delta completes, Sum Total Gas Cost must proceed as specified by: Combine costs.
After Sum Total Gas Cost completes, the system must transition to MCOPY Gas Cost Computed with all state invariants preserved.
Before Determine Overlap Type can execute, the system must be in Source/Destination May Overlap.
After Determine Overlap Type completes, the system must transition to No Overlap with all state invariants preserved.
After Determine Overlap Type completes, the system must transition to Forward Overlap (src < dst) with all state invariants preserved.
After Determine Overlap Type completes, the system must transition to Backward Overlap (dst < src) with all state invariants preserved.
Before Copy As If Using Intermediate Buffer can execute, the system must be in No Overlap.
Before Copy As If Using Intermediate Buffer can execute, the system must be in Forward Overlap (src < dst).
Before Copy As If Using Intermediate Buffer can execute, the system must be in Backward Overlap (dst < src).
After Copy As If Using Intermediate Buffer completes, the system must transition to Correct Copy Result with all state invariants preserved.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP5656-01): The specification does not explicitly document error conditions beyond gas exhaustion — the system must enforce: Assume MCOPY only fails on out-of-gas. Stack underflow is handled by general EVM stack rules. Memory automatically expands.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP5656-02): The phrase 'as if an intermediate buffer was used' describes semantics but not implementation requirement — the system must enforce: Assume implementations may use any method (memmove, reverse copy, actual buffer) as long as the result matches buffered copy semantics.

The system assumes: Implementations handle overlapping regions efficiently without actually allocating an intermediate buffer. If violated: Naive implementations using actual buffers could create DoS vectors via memory allocation attacks

The system assumes: The quadratic memory cost formula provides sufficient DoS protection for MCOPY operations. If violated: If memory pricing is insufficient, attackers could exhaust node memory through large MCOPY operations
The system assumes: Gas metering accurately reflects computational cost of memory copy operations. If violated: Underpriced MCOPY could be used for resource exhaustion attacks against nodes

All data received via Full node provides LightClientHeader to light client from EXT-EL-NETWORK-PEER must be validated before processing. Block difficulty must be independently computed from parent header and compared against claimed difficulty. Difficulty bomb delay offset (9,000,000 for Muir Glacier) must be correctly applied. Invalid difficulty must cause block rejection.
If input from EXT-EL-NETWORK-PEER via Full node provides LightClientHeader to light client fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
Before Check Header Fork Epoch can execute, the system must be in LightClientHeader Received.
After Check Header Fork Epoch completes, Validate Pre-Capella Header must proceed as specified by: Header is pre-Capella epoch.
After Check Header Fork Epoch completes, Validate Execution Payload Merkle Branch must proceed as specified by: Header is post-Capella epoch.
After Validate Pre-Capella Header completes, the system must transition to Header Validated Successfully with all state invariants preserved.
After Validate Execution Payload Merkle Branch completes, the system must transition to Header Validated Successfully with all state invariants preserved.
After Validate Execution Payload Merkle Branch completes, the system must transition to Header Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.
After Validate Pre-Capella Header completes, the system must transition to Header Validation Failed with all state invariants preserved.

All data received via Request bootstrap from a full node from EXT-LIGHT-CLIENT-CL must be validated before processing. Full nodes must serve data with valid Merkle proofs. Light clients must verify sync committee signatures and proofs. Updates must be ranked by is_better_update. Data withholding cannot be detected cryptographically.
If input from EXT-LIGHT-CLIENT-CL via Request bootstrap from a full node fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
Data from external entity EXT-FULL-NODE via Full node provides LightClientBootstrap must be treated as untrusted and validated.
After Receive LightClientBootstrap completes, Verify Bootstrap Data must proceed as specified by: Validate bootstrap Merkle proofs.
After Verify Bootstrap Data completes, the system must transition to Light Client Synced to Checkpoint with all state invariants preserved.
Before Process LightClientUpdate can execute, the system must be in Light Client Synced to Checkpoint.
After Process LightClientUpdate completes, the system must transition to Light Client Following Chain with all state invariants preserved.

All data received via Potentially malicious server sends update from EXT-UNTRUSTED-LC-SERVER must be validated before processing. Full cryptographic verification pipeline required: sync committee signature verification, finality Merkle proof verification, execution payload Merkle proof verification (Capella+). No update should be applied without passing all validation steps.
If input from EXT-UNTRUSTED-LC-SERVER via Potentially malicious server sends update fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
Before Verify Sync Committee Signatures can execute, the system must be in Untrusted Update Received.
After Verify Sync Committee Signatures completes, Verify Finality Merkle Proof must proceed as specified by: Signatures valid; verify finality proof.
After Verify Finality Merkle Proof completes, Verify Execution Payload Proof must proceed as specified by: Finality proof valid; verify execution proof.
After Verify Execution Payload Proof completes, the system must transition to Update Cryptographically Verified with all state invariants preserved.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-CAPELLA-LC-01): The specification does not define the minimum number of sync committee signatures required to accept an update. — the system must enforce: Assume the threshold is inherited from the Altair light client spec (typically > 1/3 of the 512-member sync committee). This is a critical security parameter that should be verified.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-CAPELLA-LC-02): EXECUTION_PAYLOAD_GINDEX = 25 is defined without explaining its derivation from the BeaconBlockBody Merkle tree structure. — the system must enforce: Assume gindex 25 corresponds to the correct position of the execution_payload field in the generalized Merkle tree of BeaconBlockBody. This is a constant that must match the SSZ container field ordering.

The system assumes: The light client trusts that the sync committee was honestly elected and that a supermajority of committee members are honest.. If violated: A corrupted sync committee could sign fraudulent headers, causing the light client to accept an invalid chain state including incorrect execution payload data.

The system assumes: The light client can connect to at least one honest full node to receive correct bootstrap and update data.. If violated: If all connected servers are malicious, the light client could be bootstrapped onto a fake chain, even with valid-looking signatures from a dishonest sync committee majority.
Before Check Fork Epoch Condition can execute, the system must be in Beacon State at Deneb.
After Check Fork Epoch Condition completes, Execute upgrade_to_eip6800 must proceed as specified by: Epoch matches EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH.
After Check Fork Epoch Condition completes, the system must transition to Fork Condition Not Met with all state invariants preserved.
After Execute upgrade_to_eip6800 completes, the system must transition to Beacon State at EIP-6800 with all state invariants preserved.
Before Validate Fork Version Update can execute, the system must be in Slot at Epoch Boundary.
After Validate Fork Version Update completes, Validate Witness Root Initialization must proceed as specified by: Fork version correctly updated.
After Validate Witness Root Initialization completes, Validate State Field Continuity must proceed as specified by: Witness root correctly initialized.
After Validate State Field Continuity completes, the system must transition to Fork Transition Valid with all state invariants preserved.
Before Initialize Empty Witness Root can execute, the system must be in No Execution Witness Tracking.
After Initialize Empty Witness Root completes, the system must transition to Execution Witness Tracking Active with all state invariants preserved.
Before Validate Block with Execution Witness can execute, the system must be in Execution Witness Tracking Active.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP6800-01): The specification does not define behavior for skipped slots at the fork boundary. The upgrade runs within process_slots but what happens if the fork epoch slot is skipped. — the system must enforce: Assume the upgrade triggers at the first slot of the fork epoch regardless of whether a block is proposed for that slot. The process_slots function handles the upgrade independent of block proposals.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP6800-02): Configuration values are marked as 'not definitive' and the document is described as 'work-in-progress for researchers'. — the system must enforce: Use the stated values (EIP6800_FORK_VERSION=0x05000000) as placeholder constants. Mark all derived behavior as subject to change.

The system assumes: All validator nodes will apply the identical upgrade_to_eip6800 function at the same epoch, producing identical post-fork states.. If violated: Divergent implementations could cause chain splits at the fork boundary, with different validators operating on incompatible state roots.

The system assumes: The empty ExecutionWitness initialization ([], []) is a safe starting point that will not create validation edge cases for the first post-fork block.. If violated: If the first post-fork block's witness validation logic cannot handle the transition from empty witness, it could stall the chain.
Data from external entity EXT-TRANSACTION-EXECUTION via Transaction touches account via transfer or call must be treated as untrusted and validated.
Before Check if Account Empty can execute, the system must be in Account Touched in Transaction.
After Check if Account Empty completes, the system must transition to Account is Empty with all state invariants preserved.
After Check if Account Empty completes, the system must transition to Account is Not Empty with all state invariants preserved.
Before Delete Empty Account can execute, the system must be in Account is Empty.
After Delete Empty Account completes, the system must transition to Account Deleted from State with all state invariants preserved.
Data from external entity EXT-EVM-CREATE via CREATE/CREATE2 opcode executed must be treated as untrusted and validated.
Before Execute Init Code can execute, the system must be in Contract Creation Pending.
After Execute Init Code completes, the system must transition to Runtime Code Produced with all state invariants preserved.
Before Check Code Size Limit can execute, the system must be in Runtime Code Produced.
After Check Code Size Limit completes, the system must transition to Code Size Within Limit with all state invariants preserved.
After Check Code Size Limit completes, the system must transition to Code Size Limit Exceeded with all state invariants preserved.
Before Deploy Contract Code can execute, the system must be in Code Size Within Limit.
After Deploy Contract Code completes, the system must transition to Contract Deployed with all state invariants preserved.
Before Revert Contract Creation can execute, the system must be in Code Size Limit Exceeded.
After Revert Contract Creation completes, the system must transition to Contract Creation Failed with all state invariants preserved.
Data from external entity EXT-EVM-INTERPRETER via EVM executes EXP instruction must be treated as untrusted and validated.
Before Read Exponent from Stack can execute, the system must be in EXP Opcode Encountered.
After Read Exponent from Stack completes, Calculate Exponent Byte Size must proceed as specified by: Determine exponent size.
After Calculate Exponent Byte Size completes, Compute Dynamic Gas Cost must proceed as specified by: Apply Spurious Dragon pricing.
After Compute Dynamic Gas Cost completes, Deduct Gas must proceed as specified by: Charge computed gas.
After Deduct Gas completes, the system must transition to Gas Deducted with all state invariants preserved.
After Deduct Gas completes, the system must transition to Out of Gas with all state invariants preserved.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-SPURIOUS-01): The index page does not show specific implementation details of state clearing rules — the system must enforce: Assume EIP-161 standard behavior: empty accounts (balance=0, nonce=0, code=empty) are deleted when touched

Despite ambiguity (AMB-SPURIOUS-02): Definition of 'touched' account is not visible in index — the system must enforce: Assume touched means any account accessed via CALL, CALLCODE, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL, or receiving a transfer

The system assumes: The 24KB code size limit applies only to newly deployed contracts, not existing ones. If violated: Existing contracts over 24KB would become invalid, breaking deployed applications
The system assumes: Block number is used to determine fork activation for rule changes. If violated: Inconsistent fork activation across clients would cause network splits
The system assumes: State bloat attacks were economically feasible before EIP-161 state clearing. If violated: The mitigation would be unnecessary if attack wasn't viable

All data received via Block proposer includes execution payload with witness from EXT-BLOCK-PROPOSER-CL must be validated before processing. Block proposer data must be validated through complete consensus validation pipeline: slot verification, proposer eligibility, execution payload validity via Engine API, and (post-EIP-6800) Verkle witness structural and cryptographic verification.
If input from EXT-BLOCK-PROPOSER-CL via Block proposer includes execution payload with witness fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
Before Validate Parent Hash Consistency can execute, the system must be in Execution Payload with Witness Received.
After Validate Parent Hash Consistency completes, Validate RANDAO Mix must proceed as specified by: Parent hash valid, check RANDAO.
After Validate RANDAO Mix completes, Validate Timestamp Alignment must proceed as specified by: RANDAO valid, check timestamp.
After Validate Timestamp Alignment completes, Validate Blob Commitment Count must proceed as specified by: Timestamp valid, check blob commitments.
After Validate Blob Commitment Count completes, Verify Payload via Execution Engine must proceed as specified by: Commitments valid, verify with execution engine.
After Verify Payload via Execution Engine completes, Cache Payload Header with Witness Root must proceed as specified by: Engine verification passed, cache header.
After Cache Payload Header with Witness Root completes, the system must transition to Execution Payload Validated with all state invariants preserved.
Before Parse Verkle State Diff can execute, the system must be in Pre-Execution World State.
After Parse Verkle State Diff completes, Verify Verkle Proof must proceed as specified by: State diff parsed, verify cryptographic proof.
After Verify Verkle Proof completes, Apply State Diff to World State must proceed as specified by: Proof valid, apply state changes.
After Apply State Diff to World State completes, the system must transition to Post-Execution World State with all state invariants preserved.
Data from external entity EXT-NETWORK-PEER via Peer sends block with execution witness must be treated as untrusted and validated.
Before Validate Witness Data Structure can execute, the system must be in Witness Data Received from Network.
After Validate Witness Data Structure completes, Verify IPA Proof Cryptography must proceed as specified by: Structure valid, verify cryptography.
After Verify IPA Proof Cryptography completes, the system must transition to Witness Data Cryptographically Verified with all state invariants preserved.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP6800-01): The specification does not detail the exact verification algorithm for the VerkleProof within the consensus layer; it delegates to the execution engine. — the system must enforce: Assume the execution engine implements full Verkle proof verification including IPA verification. The consensus layer treats this as a black-box trusted oracle.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP6800-02): The relationship between execution_witness in ExecutionPayload and execution_witness_root in ExecutionPayloadHeader is implied but the hashing scheme is not specified. — the system must enforce: Assume execution_witness_root is the hash_tree_root of the ExecutionWitness container, consistent with other SSZ container commitments in the spec.

The system assumes: The execution engine is assumed to correctly verify Verkle proofs and state diffs without consensus-layer re-verification.. If violated: A compromised execution engine could accept invalid state transitions, allowing theft of funds or state corruption.

The system assumes: An attacker cannot forge valid IPA proofs for incorrect state diffs given the cryptographic assumptions of the Verkle tree scheme.. If violated: Forged proofs could allow invalid state transitions to appear valid, enabling stateless validators to accept corrupted state.

The system assumes: The MAX_STEMS (65536), VERKLE_WIDTH (256), and MAX_COMMITMENTS_PER_STEM (33) limits are sufficient to represent all state changes in a single block.. If violated: Blocks requiring more state changes than these limits allow could not be represented, potentially causing liveness failures.

All data received via Block header received from network from EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER-POW must be validated before processing. Block difficulty must be independently recalculated using the difficulty formula with fork-adjusted block numbers (post-Muir Glacier: max(0, block.number - 9,000,000)). Stated difficulty in headers cannot be trusted.
If input from EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER-POW via Block header received from network fails validation, the system must reject it without altering internal state.
Before Check Muir Glacier Fork Activation can execute, the system must be in Block Header Received.
After Check Muir Glacier Fork Activation completes, the system must transition to Pre-Muir Glacier with all state invariants preserved.
After Check Muir Glacier Fork Activation completes, the system must transition to Post-Muir Glacier with all state invariants preserved.
Before Compute Fake Block Number can execute, the system must be in Post-Muir Glacier.
Before Use Actual Block Number can execute, the system must be in Pre-Muir Glacier.
After Compute Fake Block Number completes, Compute Block Difficulty must proceed as specified by: Use fake block number for difficulty.
After Use Actual Block Number completes, Compute Block Difficulty must proceed as specified by: Use actual block number for difficulty.
After Compute Block Difficulty completes, the system must transition to Difficulty Computed with all state invariants preserved.
Data from external entity EXT-BLOCK-PRODUCER via Block submitted for validation must be treated as untrusted and validated.
Before Compute Expected Difficulty can execute, the system must be in Block Pending Difficulty Validation.
After Compute Expected Difficulty completes, Compare Block Difficulty must proceed as specified by: Compare with stated difficulty.
After Compare Block Difficulty completes, the system must transition to Difficulty Valid with all state invariants preserved.
After Compare Block Difficulty completes, the system must transition to Difficulty Invalid with all state invariants preserved.
After Normal Block Time completes, Difficulty Bomb Starting to Impact must proceed as specified by: Block number reaches bomb activation threshold.
After Difficulty Bomb Starting to Impact completes, Ice Age Approaching must proceed as specified by: Exponential difficulty continues increasing.
Before Apply Muir Glacier Delay can execute, the system must be in Difficulty Bomb Starting to Impact.
After Apply Muir Glacier Delay completes, the system must transition to Difficulty Bomb Delayed with all state invariants preserved.
After Difficulty Bomb Delayed completes, Normal Block Time must proceed as specified by: Block times return to normal.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP2384-01): The exact block number for MUIR_GLACIER_FORK_BLKNUM is not specified in this document. — the system must enforce: Assume activation block is defined in client configurations and network coordination; mainnet was block 9,200,000.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP2384-02): The phrase 'delays the bomb by 4,000,000 blocks' vs 'offset of 9,000,000' could be confusing as they represent different concepts. — the system must enforce: The 9M offset is the subtraction applied; the 4M delay refers to how much further the bomb is pushed from its prior activation point (~block 8.8M).

The system assumes: All Ethereum clients implement the exact same difficulty calculation formula.. If violated: Consensus failure if clients compute different difficulties for the same block, causing chain splits.

The system assumes: The Muir Glacier fork is deployed before the difficulty bomb causes unacceptable block times.. If violated: Extended block times would degrade network usability and could impact security (longer confirmation times).

The system assumes: Miners/validators will upgrade to Muir Glacier-compatible clients before the fork block.. If violated: Non-upgraded miners would produce blocks with incorrect difficulty, causing them to be rejected by upgraded nodes.

The system assumes: Attackers cannot manipulate difficulty calculations to produce lower-difficulty blocks post-fork.. If violated: Potential for easier block production or chain reorganization attacks if difficulty can be manipulated.

The system assumes: A future hard fork will be deployed before the delayed bomb reactivates (in ~611 days).. If violated: The difficulty bomb would eventually cause network slowdown again if no subsequent fork addresses it.
Before User Signs Transaction Batch can execute, the system must be in User Account Has Zero Ether.
After User Signs Transaction Batch completes, the system must transition to Transaction Batch Signed with all state invariants preserved.
Before Submit to Block Proposer Service can execute, the system must be in Transaction Batch Signed.
After Submit to Block Proposer Service completes, the system must transition to Transaction Pending Proposer Evaluation with all state invariants preserved.
Before Proposer Creates Ether Funding Transaction can execute, the system must be in Transaction Pending Proposer Evaluation.
After Proposer Creates Ether Funding Transaction completes, the system must transition to User Account Temporarily Funded with all state invariants preserved.
Before Execute User Transactions can execute, the system must be in User Account Temporarily Funded.
After Execute User Transactions completes, the system must transition to User Transactions Executed with all state invariants preserved.
Before Identify Consideration to Free-For-All can execute, the system must be in User Transactions Executed.
After Identify Consideration to Free-For-All completes, the system must transition to Consideration Amount Identified with all state invariants preserved.
Before Simulate First Execution Run can execute, the system must be in Execution Context Created.
After Simulate First Execution Run completes, the system must transition to First Simulation Complete with all state invariants preserved.
Before Sign Consideration Extraction Transaction can execute, the system must be in First Simulation Complete.
After Sign Consideration Extraction Transaction completes, the system must transition to Extraction Transaction Signed with all state invariants preserved.

While in Free-For-All Contract Deployed: Well-known free-for-all bucket contract is deployed at known address.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP7768-01): The specification does not define the exact address of the 'well-known free-for-all bucket contract' — the system must enforce: Assume the contract address will be specified in a future update or deployment, and must be a pre-determined constant known to all participants.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP7768-02): The term 'valuable consideration' is used without precise definition of what constitutes value — the system must enforce: Assume consideration includes ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 tokens as explicitly mentioned, and possibly native Ether. The proposer determines value according to local business logic.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP7768-03): The specification mentions 'order transaction nonces accounting for partial execution scenarios' but does not specify the exact ordering strategy — the system must enforce: Assume users must order nonces sequentially and handle cases where only some transactions execute, with payment proportional to successful executions.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-EIP7768-04): Security considerations are noted as 'incomplete in the document' — the system must enforce: Treat this as a draft specification with significant security analysis still required before production use.

The system assumes: The block proposer is trusted to honestly execute the evaluation framework and not manipulate the execution context to steal consideration. If violated: Proposer could front-run user transactions, extract consideration without including user transactions, or manipulate execution to favor themselves.

The system assumes: Services communicating with block proposers are available and willing to relay no-ether transactions. If violated: Users would have no way to submit transactions, making the system unusable.

The system assumes: An attacker cannot predict the exact gas cost in a way that allows them to provide just enough consideration to be included but not enough to make proposer profitable. If violated: Griefing attacks where proposers lose money on transactions they evaluate but ultimately find unprofitable.

The system assumes: The free-for-all contract correctly implements the specified interface and cannot be exploited to drain tokens. If violated: Tokens deposited as consideration could be stolen by anyone, not just the intended block proposer.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-FULU-VAL-01): Nodes should dynamically adjust custody following validator balance changes - unclear how quickly adjustments must occur — the system must enforce: Assume custody adjustments happen at epoch boundaries when effective balance is recalculated. This is an assumption based on how effective balance updates work.

Despite ambiguity (AMB-FULU-VAL-02): Persist highest custody requirement across restarts - no specification of how long this persistence must last or when it can be lowered — the system must enforce: Assume the highest custody requirement persists indefinitely until the node explicitly recalculates based on current validator set. This prevents custody gaps during restarts.

The system assumes: The network has sufficient total custody coverage across all nodes to ensure every column is custodied by multiple peers. If violated: Some columns may have no custodians, making data availability verification impossible for those columns

The system assumes: Validators have sufficient storage and bandwidth to custody their required number of groups (minimum 8) per slot. If violated: Validators unable to meet custody requirements would degrade network data availability guarantees

The system assumes: The execution engine correctly provides cell-based proofs via engine_getPayloadV5 that are consistent with the blob commitments. If violated: Invalid cell proofs would cause column sidecar verification failures, potentially preventing block acceptance
